segments.text: Did you know that if you place a sliced onion in 2 liters of water, followed by 3 cloves
of garlic, a sliced lemon, ginger and cinnamon and let it boil for 10 minutes, you'll be
preparing a remedy capable of relieving dry cough, bronchitis, expelling mucus stuck in
the lungs, improving sinusitis and easing cold symptoms, can sweeten it with honey and
drink it warm, and don't forget to follow for more healthy recipes.
